lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Kuài diǎn! Wǒmen yào wǎn le.
lines.english: Hurry! We're going to be late.

lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 八点三十分。课八点开始。
lines.pinyin: Bā diǎn sānshí fēn. Kè bā diǎn kāishǐ.
lines.english: Eight thirty. Class starts at eight.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Ran to the classroom, very tired.

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Jìn qù ba, lǎoshī hái méi lái.
lines.english: Go in, teacher hasn't come yet.
